changelog:
Initial version with intelligent bookkeeping assistant features and CLI integration.

- Added a Python script for core accounting logic (`scripts/accounting.py`).
- Supports multilingual (Chinese) intelligent expense and income tracking via CLI and API.
- Enables text-based bookkeeping and integration with OCR/Speech/File parsing for image, voice, and document inputs.
- Implements automatic detection and extraction of bookkeeping info: amount, transaction type, keywords.
- Provides automated field mapping and CLI commands for adding, querying, and managing ledgers, accounts, categories, handlers, and companies.
